summary: Closure review of a preregistered paired NetOps study (Npairs=1000) that is artifact‑grounded and transparently reports the preregistered exact two‑sided McNemar as the confirmatory test (p=0.0625). Execution and analysis artifacts appear complete and internally consistent. Remaining publication‑quality defects are presentation and required disclosure/bibliography edits required by the prior terminal review and not yet resolved.
critical_issues: References are not presented as a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography built from the archived terminal_bibliographic_records; several manuscript citations remain in identifier/partial form rather than full IEEE entries.

Disclosure Statement remains overly long and includes execution/accounting details and archive bookkeeping that must be removed; the Disclosure must be condensed to a single concise paragraph preserving only the mandatory items (model(s)+provider(s); orchestration/validator names; immutable initial master prompt locator + exact SHA‑256; preregistration identifier and statement it was frozen prior to any model calls; and affirmation that no human manually edited technical manuscript content after the autonomy lock).
required_revisions: Replace the References section with a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography using the archived terminal_bibliographic_records. For each cited record include authors, title, venue/repository, year, and DOI/URL when available (do not leave bare DOI/arXiv/OpenAlex identifier entries).

Condense the Disclosure Statement to one concise paragraph that (a) declares the model(s) and provider(s), (b) names the orchestration/validator (hosted_netops_gvr_v1 / deterministic_netops_validator_v5), (c) includes the immutable initial master prompt locator and exact SHA‑256 (provenance/master_prompt.txt : 1872df1e1805d2d96940456ca016bd665d1d5196add77f5acdf1582bb39b15ba), (d) states the preregistration identifier (cand‑003‑stud‑001) and affirms it was frozen prior to any model calls, and (e) affirms that no human manually edited technical manuscript content after the autonomy lock. Remove execution/accounting numbers, per‑episode logs, artifact paths, and other archive bookkeeping from the manuscript Disclosure Statement (those belong in the archived evidence bundle).

Add or tighten one concise paragraph in Results/Discussion (≤3 sentences) that plainly states the inferential hierarchy: the preregistered exact two‑sided McNemar test is the confirmatory analysis and it did not reach two‑sided α=0.05 (p=0.0625); the paired bootstrap CI and any one‑sided McNemar reported are descriptive/exploratory and do not overturn the preregistered confirmatory null. Include one brief sentence explaining why the bootstrap CI may exclude zero with extremely sparse discordant counts (referencing the archived contingency table/bootstrap seed/artifacts).
optional_revisions: Optionally include a small boxed appendix or single small table listing the five discordant pairs (pair IDs and brief failure reason codes) to illustrate repair modes, populated from terminal_factual_accounting; this is permitted but not required.

Optionally add a one‑sentence clarification in Threats to Validity about whether the observed very high baseline validity likely arises from generator behavior, corpus characteristics, or validator permissiveness, and point to the archived artifacts a reader could inspect to adjudicate among those possibilities.
